messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — ACME renewal hitting a procurement hold. They sent PO-9945 but their AP portal shows a different EIN than the one on our invoice, so they're refusing to release payment. They also want an itemized amendment for +15 seats (start Apr 1) and an e-sign path. Can finance confirm what EIN is on file for Redwood invoices? cc Aj for pricing.

Ben Ortiz: Our billing system lists Redwood Inference EIN as `12-3456789`. If PO shows `98-7654321` that's a mismatch. Can you paste the PO snippet or upload the PDF? We can’t change our EIN — we'll either need a corrected PO from them or written acceptance from their AP referencing our W-9. I can prepare a note for AP that accompanies the invoice.

Maria Chen: Pasting the relevant lines from the PO they uploaded: 
```
PO: PO-9945
Vendor EIN: 98-7654321
Billing contact: ap@acme-corp.com
Total: $18,000
```
They wrote: "we need vendor EIN to match or invoice will be rejected." They also requested proration math and an updated order form with the 15-seat add-on.

Ben Ortiz: Okay — final: our tax id is `12-3456789`. We should send them our W-9 and a short cover note: "Invoice references PO-9945. Redwood Tax ID: 12-3456789. If the PO lists an alternate EIN, please issue a corrected PO or written confirmation from AP that they accept invoice as-is." I can generate the invoice with `Reference: PO-9945` and attach the W-9. Will hold on sending until pricing is locked.

Samira Leone: From CS: they asked for pro-rated amount for the extra seats for the remaining term (6 months left on their renewal). Aj — did Sales approve any special price for those 15 seats? We need to lock the figure before Ben issues the invoice.

Aj Patel: We approved standard renewal seat pricing: $50/user/month. Quick proration calc: 
```
15 seats * $50/month * 6 months = $4,500
```
We can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $500 (approved) to smooth the ask if procurement pushes back. Confirm and I'll update the quote.

Emma Rogers: Legal here — we cannot sign or accept a PO that misstates our EIN. We can do one of two things: 1) Ask Acme to reissue PO with correct vendor tax ID, or 2) sign an amendment that references their PO number but explicitly states Redwood's correct EIN (and include the W-9). If they insist the PO can't be changed for internal reasons, the amendment + W-9 with an explicit acceptance clause is our fallback. I'll draft the amendment language and create an e-sign link.

LegalBot: E-sign request created for "ACME Renewal Amendment": https://e.sign/xyz123 (expires in 7 days).

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Plan of action: 1) Ben to prepare invoice referencing PO-9945 and attach W-9 + cover note (hold until price confirmed). 2) Aj to send updated quote/order form with proration and onboarding credit. 3) Emma to send amendment e-sign link. 4) I'll schedule a 15-min procurement touchpoint to confirm AP will accept W-9 or reissue PO.

Ben Ortiz: I'll prepare the invoice now and include the W-9 and the suggested note: "Invoice references PO-9945; Redwood Tax ID: 12-3456789; If PO lists alternate EIN, please provide updated PO or written confirmation from AP." Will send the PDF to Maria for approval within 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

Aj Patel: Quote updated and sent to Maria. Price confirmed, onboarding credit applied. :thumbsup:

Samira Leone: I'll book the procurement call for today at 3pm PST and invite AP: ap@acme-corp.com. Will share the invoice and amendment link before the call. :calendar:

Emma Rogers: Drafted amendment language and pushed the e-sign link (same as LegalBot). Added clause: "Customer acknowledges acceptance of invoice referencing PO-9945 despite any legacy vendor identifiers and confirms AP authority to pay Redwood Inference LLC (EIN 12-3456789)." :eyes:

Maria Chen: Great — marking this as in-flight on the renewal tracker and will update the status after the 3pm call. Thanks everyone.

Ben Ortiz: Follow-up after call: if AP agrees to accept W-9 + amendment, I'll release the invoice for payment. If they require PO reissue, we'll wait for their updated PO before sending final invoice.

Emma Rogers: Noted. Thanks team.
